dataset_role: MODEL-1 historical external cohort is development-only; JUNYI_FINAL_HOLDOUT_V1 labels are prohibited in this phase.

rasch_1pl.architecture: intercept plus scalar student ability plus scalar exercise difficulty; no hidden layer

hierarchical_rasch_topic.equation: logit P(correct) = mu + theta_student - beta_exercise + delta_student_topic
hierarchical_rasch_topic.architecture: Rasch scalar terms plus one scalar student-topic deviation; no hidden layer or graph propagation
hierarchical_rasch_topic.delta_regularization: MAP-L2 penalty on observed calibration deviations only

development_refit.scope: MODEL-1 train, validation, and historical diagnostic partitions only
development_refit.epoch_policy: Use each candidate's validation-selected epoch exactly; do not reopen model selection.
